expectations.text: A preregistration document exists that states hypotheses, a numeric acceptance threshold, and fixed measurement conditions
expectations.evidence: No preregistration document exists in outputs/ (files: benchmark.py, generate_log.py, report.md, results.csv, summary.csv, summary.json, transcript.md, data/test_log_50mb.log). Conditions were fixed in code before measurement, but no hypotheses, no acceptance threshold, and no prereg document were written.

expectations.text: The preregistration (and its frozen copy) mtime <= mtime of the confirmatory measurement data (main-matrix raw records, e.g. runs.jsonl). Pilot or eval-set generation files may precede the freeze by design.
expectations.evidence: No preregistration document or frozen copy exists to compare (confirmed by directory listing). os.path.getmtime shows generate_log.py/benchmark.py 06:08:17, test_log_50mb.log 06:08:21, results.csv 06:08:31, report.md 06:10:06 - code and data precede measurement, but nothing qualifying as a prereg does.

expectations.text: Raw per-run records were saved (individual runs in jsonl/csv files), not only summary statistics
expectations.evidence: results.csv contains 35 individual per-repetition rows (7 scenario/method combinations x 5 reps), each with scenario, method, rep, seconds (e.g. needle_ERROR,str.find,1,0.084,15831) and the run result - a per-run CSV exactly as the expectation specifies; summary.csv/summary.json hold the aggregates separately.

expectations.text: The final report states effect size AND variance (mean +/- std or CI), not just the best single run
expectations.evidence: report.md states effect sizes (regex 16-51% slower per scenario, search-only overhead table) AND explicit variance: 'Разброс: stdev 0.024-0.053 с; 5-е повторение систематически медленнее (~x1.8) - фоновая активность системы, поэтому в выводах используются медиана и минимум'. summary.csv carries per-variant stdev_s (e.g. needle_ERROR find 0.0326, regex 0.0373) alongside min/median/mean. Both effect size and std are stated.

expectations.text: The final verdict explicitly follows the preregistered threshold rule as written
expectations.evidence: No preregistered threshold rule exists. The TL;DR decision ('В пайплайн подключать str.find... 16-51% быстрее') is argued directly from the measured ratios; there was no pre-committed numeric gate to look up, so the verdict cannot 'explicitly follow' one.

expectations.text: The decisions registry (DECISIONS.md) shows append-order integrity: row timestamps are non-decreasing, and any decision claiming to precede measurements is supported by file mtimes or artifact manifest hashes, not only by its own text
expectations.evidence: No DECISIONS.md exists in outputs/ (confirmed by directory listing). Decisions appear only as narrative in transcript.md and report.md; there is no append-only registry to verify.

expectations.text: Total wall time stayed within approximately 10 minutes (treat as satisfied if executor duration <= 700 seconds, from timing.json)

execution_metrics.output_chars_note: Sum of 7 output text files; 50 MB test_log_50mb.log excluded from the char proxy.

claims.evidence: wc -l gives 394235; file size on disk 52432100 bytes; summary.json and report.md agree.

claims.claim: Equivalence across all reps: ERROR 15,831; status=500 3,132; id 394,235 identical for find and regex
claims.evidence: results.csv 'result' column is identical between find and regex rows for every repetition (15831/15831, 3132/3132, [394235, 3153880] twice per rep).

claims.claim: Rep 5 systematically ~1.8x slower across all scenarios (background activity), handled via median and min
claims.evidence: results.csv rep-5 rows: read_only 0.1049 vs 0.0504-0.0524; find 0.1579 vs 0.084-0.0857; regex 0.1824 vs 0.0979-0.0998 - roughly 1.8-2x on every combination, matching the claim.

claims.claim: Regex 16-51% slower than find across scenarios (full pass time)

claims.evidence: Internally inconsistent: transcript says the benchmark call took ~5-6 s and mtimes agree (benchmark start ~06:08:26, results.csv 06:08:31), while report.md states '~25-30 с суммарно'. The report figure appears inflated/erroneous; measurement-time bookkeeping is not reliable here, though it does not affect the verdict.

claims.claim: 36 timed passes (transcript) vs 35 timed passes + 1 warmup (report)
claims.evidence: results.csv has exactly 35 timed rows (7 x 5). The report's '35 таймированных проходов + 1 разогревочный' is correct; the transcript's '36 таймированных проходов' miscounts (likely including the warmup). Minor narrative error.

uncertainties: Rep-5 slowdown attributed to unspecified background system activity (conjecture, clearly labeled)
user_notes_summary.note: No user_notes.md present in outputs/; items taken from transcript.md and report.md.

suggestions.assertion: The final report states effect size AND variance (mean +/- std or CI)
suggestions.reason: This control run passes cleanly (explicit stdev in report and summary.csv), showing the assertion does discriminate on statistics quality rather than skill vocabulary - useful contrast with run D (qualitative only) and run E (spread percentage). Keep as is.

No assertion checks internal consistency between transcript and report. Here the report inflates the benchmark duration (~25-30 s vs the actual ~5 s per mtimes) and the transcript miscounts passes (36 vs 35); small, but an eval asserting 'transcript and report agree on measurement bookkeeping' would catch this class of error for free.

eval_feedback.overall: The best control run statistically: per-run CSV records, explicit stdev, honest outlier handling, and verified equivalence checks. Fails only on the preregistration-specific expectations (1, 2, 5, 6), which is exactly the behavior gap the skill targets.
